page.overview:
Who is Llana?

Llana is an Aes Sedai of the Red Ajah, and is also of the Black Ajah.

Llana is part of the Red Ajah's mission to capture Mazrim Taim. However, she is also sent by the Black Ajah in order to kidnap Taim before he can be brought to the White Tower and gentled.
